faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Engineer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Project Engineer position at IIT Gandhinagar is 09 October 2026. Ensure you apply before this deadline to be considered.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Ph.D. or equivalent in the relevant branch with a strong academic record, or an M.Tech./M.S. with at least 2 years of post-qualification experience in teaching, research, or industry.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Engineer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Engineer role will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 60,000 to Rs. 1,25,000.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Engineer post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Project Engineer position in this recruitment drive by IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the IIT Gandhinagar Project Engineer recruitment is entirely online. Candidates must submit their applications through the official website.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Project Engineer position at IIT Gandhinagar is a contractual role. This means the appointment will be for a fixed tenure.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is SPON/10455/Adv0328 DATED 21.09.2026.

faq.question: Q9. Does IIT Gandhinagar offer age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify age relaxation details. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for any information regarding age relaxation.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the Important Links section of this article. It contains all the detailed information about the recruitment.
